checks.name: Approved default is self-contained artwork; custom logos keep their original URL
Four-language standard categories localize safely while unknown business labels remain exact
Public contact URLs reject executable schemes and normalize WhatsApp to international digits
Foreground test produces exactly three two-note rings and optional single ring
Deep links target exact original request records
Service worker push respects persisted account binding, visible clients, event tags and guarded deep links
Server push restricts endpoints and requires a private dispatcher credential
Customer theme preference defaults to light and stays separate from administrator accents

limitations: Real browser subscription, external push transport, physical installed PWA and OS delivery require deployment acceptance.
